title: At a glance: what moved your money today
summary: At a glance is Astor’s five-second portfolio check: two lines on what moved your money today and why, a daily chart, and a brief before the open.
body_markdown:
## What does At a glance show you?


The daily chart shows how your portfolio moved over the day, and the Astor Take explains that move in two lines of plain English.


Two lines is a deliberate limit. On most days the honest answer is short, like one holding that reported earnings or one sector that sold off on a headline. When it isn’t short, you can ask Astor for the longer version.


Here’s a hypothetical. Say you own a few chip companies, a bank and an index fund, and your portfolio is down 2% on a day the broader market barely moved (illustrative numbers). The Astor Take might say that most of the drop came from your chip holdings after a large chipmaker gave a weak outlook, and that the rest of your portfolio was close to flat. That tells you where to look, which a percentage on its own can’t.
